1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Oxervate  
Diagnosis 
Neurotrophic keratitis  
Approval Length 
8 Weeks (maximum of 8 weeks per eye per lifetime)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Stage 2 or 3 neurotrophic keratitis  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 1360 ---
Page 1360 
 
2 - History of failure to at least one OTC ocular artificial tear product (e.g., Systane® Ultra, 
Akwa® Tears, Refresh Optive®, Soothe® XP)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Ophthalmologist  
• 
Optometrist  
Notes  
Note: Authorization maximum coverage is limited to one 8-week appro
val per eye. Oxervate is hard-coded with a quantity limit of 112 mL per
 lifetime.
